subcategory_text: Identify and evaluate application-security threats during design and architecture stages, and incorporate mitigations into the design.
implementation_examples: L1: Perform ad-hoc threat modelling for new features
L2: Standardise threat modelling with templates and reuse per feature
L3: Use attacker-centric modelling and abuse cases at design time
assessment_objectives: Determine whether threat modelling is performed at design.
Determine whether mitigations are tracked to threats.
